data.body: Patch set 1 of 3202 got Verified -1: tests/unit/test_opcert_binding_thread_propagation_ff4a.py::test_no_mcp_tool_daemon_spawns_a_bare_thread failed on all 3 pytest cells because the sweep thread was a bare threading.Thread. Patch set 2 (a41975c8a6fbaa5330377c2dd8d396888bd3c6f1) spawns it through spawn_context_daemon under tracked_work(gauge.hold), and adds a test for a RemovedInputError raised inside the background sweep (an LLM-Review advisory finding): it is logged at ERROR and the gauge is released. A wider local set of 130 test files (MCP, opcert binding, ensures, threading scans) gave 1980 passed and 26 skipped; make lint and make typecheck pass.
